stage: post-literature comparator addition before Firth results
reason: Kessels, Jones and Goos (JCM 2019) makes human-only Firth a directly relevant mature comparator.
estimator: Human negative log likelihood minus one half log determinant of summed expected human information
power: fixed Jeffreys exponent one half, no tuning
resources: Same human rows as the original seven methods and two DY settings; Firth uses no auxiliary predictions.
point_selection: Smallest penalized negative log likelihood among converged positive-Hessian adjusted-score fits; no global optimality certificate.
intervals: Conventional inverse expected information Wald, not profile likelihood; distinct from the existing sandwich convention.
metrics: paired errors versus all nine retained baseline settings
precision_unit: original repetition, not one of the eleven coefficients
validation: all original human availability and available MSE checks
all new root and covariance rechecks
reporting: Retain every repetition and every optimizer start, including failures, adverse comparisons and different interval conventions. No superiority, innovation or acceptance claim from availability alone.
